name: deploy-vercel
description: Vercel deployment: vercel.json (framework + regions) and a PR preview workflow that verifies and builds before merge

exports.name: previewWorkflow
exports.description: PR preview: type-check, lint, test, build

instructions: Link the project with `vercel link` and set the provider environment variables in the Vercel dashboard (or `vercel env add`). They are read at build/runtime exactly like `.env.local`.
Production deploys are deliberately not automated by this module: run `vercel --prod` or set up a production deployment in the dashboard when you are ready to ship.
